values./system/biography: A giant squid mutated to colossal size by the leaking reactor of the USS Everness.
values./items/@a35fa0d33e063ebf/system/descript: This creature can swim and remain submerged indefinitely and suffers no underwater attack or movement penalties.
values./items/@59c1279616e99c06/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@2573fa660d0a7be0/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@95a6ac731b3ea2ec/system/descript: +2 HP per level is included; Defense is reduced by 2 and critical hits require 9 damage.
values./items/@02456cbb5d757893/system/descript: It has twelve limbs and may attack two targets with one attack action; injuries remove limbs.
values./items/@9298f14669b1eac7/system/descript: After a successful Tentacle Slam it may spend 2 AP to restrain each target until the end of its next turn on a failed difficulty 2 Athletics test.
values./items/@38747fbf38f0f48a/system/descript: Radioactive Ink creates a persistent glowing cloud hazard in its target zone.
